name: The Ruins of Farahlon
shortDescription: The Ruins of Farahlon, a named setting in the Consortium and Arcatraz research story.
body: The quest’s named target area for the moving Ata’mal Crystal and Culuthas encounter. Its story art is interpretive; no exact map coordinate, dungeon floor plan or travel route is asserted. See docs/research/consortium-and-arcatraz-visual-assets.json.
